Game Overview

In Poppy Strike 3, the core idea is straightforward: engage in Poppy Strike 3's intense first-person battles, pitting your survival instincts against the enigmatic Huggy Wuggy. Navigate eerie environments and master a variety of weapons. Stay alert and strategic, as each chilling encounter demands quick reflexes and precise aim to triumph over waves of relentless threats.
